literal_meaning: bodily knot of grasping at habits and observances
preferred_translation: bodily knot of grasping at habits and observances
definition: A named member of the fourfold kāyagantha family.
notes: This compound should inherit the gantha headword policy while keeping the established rendering for sīlabbata-parāmāsa stable. Do not reduce it to generic ritualism or vague attachment to practice.

example_phrases.translation: grasping at habits and observances is a bodily knot
example_phrases.notes: Shows a named member of the fourfold knot family.

version_notes: The sīlabbata stem was moved from rules and observances to habits and observances, keeping this knot entry aligned with sīlabbata-parāmāsa and sīlabbatupādāna.
